metadata.title: Fez & Bariz — Moroccan Handmade Clothing
metadata.description: Jellabas, jabadors and caftans handmade by Moroccan artisans. Shipping in Morocco and worldwide.

home.heroSubtitle: Jellabas, jabadors and caftans handmade by Moroccan artisans, for you and your family.
home.storyTitle: A craft passed down through generations
home.storyText: Every piece is handmade by Moroccan artisans using traditional techniques: embroidery, weaving and time-honoured finishing. By choosing Fez & Bariz, you directly support these artisans and help keep a unique heritage alive.

about.title: Our story
about.intro: Fez & Bariz was born from a passion for Moroccan textile craftsmanship and a desire to share it beyond borders.
about.missionText: We work directly with artisans and cooperatives in Morocco to offer authentic pieces, handmade following traditional methods, while ensuring fair compensation.
about.qualityText: Every jellaba, jabador and caftan is made from carefully selected materials using artisanal techniques passed down through generations.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.intro: A question about a product, an order, or a custom request? Write to us, we'll get back to you quickly.
